title: Low quality throw with bald patches
text:
Low quality throw with bald patches. This red and black plaid throw is pretty and it feels velvety. It is thin like all other throws. Unfortunately, I am so sorry I ordered it as it is not worth what I will be paying for it.

This is a standard-sized throw but there are bald patches and lint throughout the entire throw as can be seen from the photos. I personally feel this is not worth more than $12 as the quality is substandard. I am sorry I believed the five star ratings of other reviewers at the time I decided to order this.
